text: ZX81 WEATHER WALL 31 OCT 18:09Z. image.alt: A 10x10 wall of 100 ZX81 screens rendering a live world weather map in 1-bit block graphics. Alerts: coastal flood warning RUSSIA; extreme heat warning AUSTRALIA; winter storm warning RUSSIA; high wind warning RUSSIA, CROATIA; heavy rain warning ITALY, SPAIN, GREECE, PORTUGAL; severe thunderstorm warning ECUADOR, GREECE; river flooding melbourne; INFA 953MB S CHINA; sweltering night W AFRICA 28C, TROP ATL 26C, SE ASIA 26C, N INDIA 25C, W PACIFIC 25C; hot night N ATLANTIC 22C, S INDIA 21C, CARIBBEAN 20C; hazardous smoke E ASIA; drought emergency EUROPE, W AFRICA (GDACS). Hottest 30C at SANTO DOMING, coldest 1C at URUMQI. Precipitation: rain areas and snow or wintry areas. Roughest seas at N PACIFIC. Notable: smoky, unhealthy air over ARABIA, MONGOLIA. Notable: dense fog in C AFRICA. 6 further wildfires burning.
